{{Top|leg}}
'''Spectacilin''' was a type of medicine used during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the early years of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], notably during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It was a broad-spectrum RNA polymerase inhibitor capable of eliminating very strong [[Drongaran]] sicknesses and slight infections.
